title: Enclose the editor with an elevated modeline and frame
summary: User accepted the repaired workspace frame and asked for the next step. Bounded frame outcome complete; M0 quadratic authoring remains a separate proposal.

verificationRecords.notes: Initial added test accessed inert on an HTMLElement-or-SVGElement locator. Replaced with the DOM attribute assertion; complete consumer typecheck now passes.

Initial exemplar check used the wrong accessible name for the Vim query. Corrected to Search Vim bindings; the headerless frame cases passed, including modal focus, overlap, phone layout and large-text errors.

Initial full suite: 31 passed, three multi-tab cases timed out looking for the retained Chat toolbar button. The compatibility fixture set header visibility only on the first page. Moved it to the browser context so all tabs use the same explicit layout; full rerun in progress.
Correction to the earlier grep-spelling record: this was the actual initial exemplar invocation. It failed on the test-only wrong Vim-query label, then passed after correcting the accessible name.
Complete notebook and chat consumer, including browser cases, passes after the test locator type repair.
All 28 existing notebook, object, command, picker and reader correctness cases passed.
All 25 chat state, persistence, annotation, delivery and transport cases passed.
All 75 dashboard and orientation checks passed with the approved frame contract selected and existing startup budgets unchanged.

The pressure case reproduced a real boundary defect: Vim coverage observed the fixed-height root, so enlarging the modeline did not update its available height. Changed the observer to the pane area and added growth/reversal coverage.

All three headerless cases pass after the repair: forced modal overlap; query focus and draft caret; fruit feedback; visible preview and persistence errors in narrow reading mode; larger text; and growth/reversal while Vim coverage is open.
Complete consumer typecheck passes after the final pane-height observer repair.

Final clean suite: all 35 Chromium cases passed. Includes three headerless frame cases, forced real modal overlap, grow/reverse sizing, visible persistent errors after successful preview, draft focus/history/streaming, multi-tab branches and notes, fixed panes and native reader preservation. Earlier fixture failures and geometry regression are retained with their repairs.

verificationRecords.command: npm run visual:fraction-notebook -- --grep 'focused source|modal cursors|help, Ex|Styles compares|light canvas|phone focused'
verificationRecords.notes: Initial affected group: six passed and source-reload acknowledgement timed out at five seconds, remaining at Preview checked / waiting for the reading. The exact isolated case passed unchanged in 5.3 seconds total. No deterministic source defect identified; final group rerun retains all assertions and timeouts.

verificationRecords.command: npm run visual:fraction-notebook -- --grep 'focused source|modal cursors|help, Ex|Styles compares|light canvas|phone focused'
verificationRecords.notes: Final complete affected group: all seven Chromium cases passed unchanged. Source reload/Run also passed in isolation after one acknowledgement timeout. Retain that intermittent observation; no deterministic cause was established and no timeout or assertion was relaxed. Native player/moment, cursors, Ex, style references, light spacing and phone source/result checks passed.
Dedicated Chromium Vim coverage command completed successfully; its last-run result records passed with no failed tests. Native modal focus, rows and filters retain their scoped coverage.
Final source-linked checked-candidate update: all 75 checks passed; frame visual acceptance remains pending.

Intentional regression reproduction with the old deferred-only preview stylesheet: parent default was light but embedded native body remained dark while preview.ts was blocked. The first-paint theme invariant fails before its editing bridge. Reapply the early render-blocking theme import and rerun unchanged assertions.

verificationRecords.command: npm run visual:fraction-notebook -- --grep "theme|default beige|light canvas|Styles compares"
verificationRecords.notes: First revised-theme group: five passed, two failed. Early reader color assertions pass, but a fixed 150ms iframe paint sample found no frames; use observable frame arrival. The existing custom-color correction case remained at its previous green after Tab; isolate to distinguish a reproducible interaction defect.

Isolation reproduced invalid-style correction failure. Event trace showed synchronous reportValidity during blur reentered focus; the next fill never reached the input. Replace that popup with accessible inline validation. Reader paint sampling now runs from the parent render loop, avoiding throttled iframe callbacks; unchanged paper/ink/scheme assertions pass.

verificationRecords.command: npm run visual:fraction-notebook -- --grep "theme|default beige|light canvas|Styles compares|focused source|help, Ex|phone focused"
verificationRecords.notes: Nine passed, including default/saved/corrupt startup and corrected style entry. Two legacy expectations still assumed a visible Saved locally message and dark default green. Update the save case to the actionable Source changes need Run notice, preserving its reload/run assertions; select dark explicitly in the inherited-color switching case.

All 35 Chromium cases passed on the quiet padded modeline revision, including headerless commands, modal overlap and caret return, phone/large text, streaming, independent editors and multi-tab recovery.
Affected complete consumer typecheck passed after modeline simplification, early preview stylesheet and inline style-validation repair.
All 28 focused notebook, compiler, row, command and object checks passed.
All 25 native session, persistence, transcript and recovery checks passed.
All 75 source-linked vision, orientation and dashboard checks passed after recording the requested revision.

verificationRecords.command: npm run visual:fraction-notebook -- --grep "theme|default beige|light canvas|Styles compares|focused source|help, Ex|phone focused"
verificationRecords.notes: All 11 affected Chromium cases pass: default beige before the delayed bridge, explicit dark and saved custom first paint, corrupt preferences preserved, invalid-style correction, native source/Run/reload, cursors, Ex, phone and light canvas. No timeout was relaxed.
All six scoped Chromium cases pass, preserving reference search, native focus/carets, lazy-load cancellation/recovery and filter state.

verificationRecords.command: npm run visual:editor-chat -- --grep "workspace frame pane focus"
verificationRecords.notes: Reproduced before repair: focused KP section paints a native auto 1px rgb(0,95,204) outline; screenshot shows the reported blue left edge. The iframe itself has no outline. Host shadow and border are otherwise the named theme tokens.

verificationRecords.command: npm run visual:editor-chat -- --grep "workspace frame pane focus"
verificationRecords.notes: After outline repair, delayed startup, modal return, both themes, child input focus and forced-colors checks passed. Returning to editing exposed an existing ordering defect: focus was requested while the document was still inert. Move the existing layout transition before the focus request and retain the regression.

verificationRecords.command: npm run visual:editor-chat -- --grep "workspace frame pane focus"
verificationRecords.notes: Regression passes after reproducing the native blue outline. Covers delayed reading startup, picker return, light/dark, child input focus, forced-colors, stable pane geometry and actual document focus on returning to editing.
Complete affected consumer typecheck passes after the pane paint and inert-before-focus ordering repair.
All six Chromium Vim reference and focus-return cases pass after the pane outline and editing-focus repair.
All 36 chat browser cases passed, including pane startup focus, picker dismissal, both themes, forced colors and edit focus restoration.
Acceptance handoff exceeded the 650-word roadmap budget at 661 words; shortened the charter pointer while preserving priorities and boundaries. No budget increase.
All 75 checks pass after shortening the roadmap within its unchanged 650-word ceiling. Accepted frame closure and proposed mathematical successor agree across sources.
Reports resolved frame at three of three packages and M0 quadratic authoring as proposed next; no new implementation approval inferred.
